author_track: G4-A (real PIT series 1990-1996 and extended-window calibration rules)
title: PIT data calibration 0.3: 19-series lens audit for 1990-1996 and the rules for using the extended window

supersedes_lineage.0.1: protocols/pit_reconstruction.json (schema v2, docs/108): the reconstruction build and the revision dossier (no separate preregistration document)
supersedes_lineage.0.2: protocols/evaluation_protocol_v5.json data_depth.reconstruction: protocol classes REAL_TIME_RECONSTRUCTED_MARKET / RECONSTRUCTED_PIT and W1_EXT, frozen 2026-11-14
supersedes_lineage.0.3: this file: the 19-series lens calibration and the extended-window usage rules; the first machine-readable PIT preregistration
supersedes_lineage.note: the numbering follows the calibration lineage (docs/92, docs/98, docs/158 -> here); 0.1/0.2 are documents/protocol sections, not machine-readable files

v5.role: current frozen protocol for new evaluations; provides the reconstruction classes, W1_EXT and the admission rules

v4.role: frozen and unchanged; T2 keeps the v4 REAL_TIME-only rule (no reconstructed GDP)

window.grid: monthly vintage dates on the 15th (83 dates)
window.archive_window_definition: a vintage date counts as inside the window when it lies in [start, end]

reconstruction_dossier.role: reconstruction build facts and revision dossier (docs/108)

revision_classes.ZERO_WITHIN_ROUNDING: max_abs <= 0.01 and mean_abs <= 0.001 (publication rounding of a rate)
revision_classes.SMALL: mean_abs <= 0.05 and max_abs <= 0.5 (usable as RECONSTRUCTED_PIT with sensitivity)
revision_classes.MATERIAL: otherwise (not usable for an admission-relevant target without genuine archives)

frozen_thresholds.why_frozen: the lens and class thresholds are calibrated on the archive dates and the measured earliest-vs-latest revisions only; they must not be changed after any extended-window result is seen (see amendment_rule)

lens_rules.ARCHIVED_PIT: genuine ALFRED vintage columns cover the whole window (first real vintage on or before the window start and at least G4_MIN_ARCHIVED_VINTAGES columns inside)
lens_rules.TAPE_RECONSTRUCTED: the archive starts inside the window or is too sparse: the early part is the declared first-print tape (revision class decides usability)
lens_rules.UNVERIFIED_LATE_ARCHIVE: the archive starts more than G4_TAPE_MAX_DELAY_MONTHS after the window end (or has no vintage column inside the window and a late start): 1990-1996 cannot be reconstructed honestly and the series is excluded
lens_rules.LATEST_ONLY: no vintage archive at all (USREC): only latest.csv is copied
lens_rules.MISSING_SOURCE: neither the archive nor latest.csv is available locally

USREC.protocol_use: NBER chronology representation for T3 labels

excluded_series.reason: the archive starts more than G4_TAPE_MAX_DELAY_MONTHS after the window end (or has no vintage column inside the window and a late start): 1990-1996 cannot be reconstructed honestly and the series is excluded

the archive starts more than G4_TAPE_MAX_DELAY_MONTHS after the window end (or has no vintage column inside the window and a late start): 1990-1996 cannot be reconstructed honestly and the series is excluded

the archive starts more than G4_TAPE_MAX_DELAY_MONTHS after the window end (or has no vintage column inside the window and a late start): 1990-1996 cannot be reconstructed honestly and the series is excluded

lens_calibration.what_is_calibrated: the lens/status assignment of every series for 1990-1996 and its usability/protocol class; NOT any model parameter and NOT any forecast
lens_calibration.classification_inputs: archive vintage dates and counts, dense-start date, measured earliest-vs-latest revisions; no forecast errors and no target outcomes enter the classification
lens_calibration.outcome_free_declaration: the classification was computed before any extended-window evaluation and does not depend on its results
lens_calibration.protocol_series_rule: for the series that protocol v5 itself classes (CPIAUCSL, CPILFESL, UNRATE, GDPC1, GS10, TB3MS, USREC) the protocol class is used verbatim; the audit only reproduces it and records the measured revision class next to it
lens_calibration.auxiliary_rule: auxiliary series are ARCHIVED_PIT when a genuine full-history archive covers the window (start gap <= archived_start_tolerance_days); otherwise the first-print tape is used and the relative window revision class decides the usability

W1_EXT.use: T1 C4 only: origins before the first real ALFRED vintage (1996-12-31) are reconstructed and flagged (protocol v5)

W2.use: held-out OOS window; not used for any selection or tuning

extended_window_design.primary_analysis: T1 C4 on W1_EXT per protocol v5; C1/C2/C5 stay REAL_TIME-only and are never computed on reconstructed origins
mandatory_sensitivity: REAL_TIME-only slice of the C4 (reporting-only, not gating)
extended_window_design.conditional_data_class: a C4 pass that depends on reconstructed origins advances the pair to SHADOW_TEST only with the CONDITIONAL_DATA_CLASS label recorded in the report, decision log and model card (protocol v5)

not_included.T2_GDP_GROWTH: no reconstructed GDPC1 is admitted; T2 keeps the v4 REAL_TIME-only rule and starts at the first real vintage (1996-12)
not_included.T3_RECESSION: T3 W1 starts 1996-12; the NBER announcement-date rule is unchanged
not_included.model_parameter_tuning: no parameter grid/search is pre-registered here; any future calibration of model parameters needs its own preregistration version and hash before the computation
not_included.auxiliary_diagnostic_series: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY lenses may be reported as context but must not enter an admission-relevant criterion

data_acceptance: a series may feed an admission-relevant input only through the protocol class of its lens: REAL_TIME, REAL_TIME_RECONSTRUCTED_MARKET or RECONSTRUCTED_PIT
DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and NOT_AVAILABLE lenses never enter a target or a comparator minimum
T1 C4 on W1_EXT requires CPIAUCSL lens in {TAPE_RECONSTRUCTED, ARCHIVED_PIT} and CPILFESL/UNRATE likewise; the measured revision classes are reported next to the result
T2 requires GDPC1 REAL_TIME only (first real vintage 1996-12); no reconstructed GDP
T3 labels come from USREC/NBER announcements; USREC has no vintage archive and is used as a label source only
at least 60 CPI y/y observations and 12 recession-labelled origins in W1_EXT are required for the respective C4; otherwise the C4 is NOT_APPLICABLE, not FAIL

evaluation_criteria.C1: relative loss <= the threshold from protocols/nf_sim_thresholds.json (0.97 for the reported targets); the primary loss is RMSE, CRPS only after the mixture gate
evaluation_criteria.C2: one-sided Diebold-Mariano plus full Romano-Wolf stepdown, FWER 0.10
evaluation_criteria.C4: protocol v5 C4 rule on W1_EXT with the sensitivity slices above
evaluation_criteria.conditional_rule: a pass that depends on reconstructed origins is CONDITIONAL (CONDITIONAL_DATA_CLASS), never an unconditional PASS
evaluation_criteria.no_claim_rule: no significance, ranking or admission claim is made from this preregistration alone; the evaluation report must carry the sha256 of this file and of the coverage audit

reporting_requirements: report must state the lens/protocol class of every input series used
report must carry the flags: data_class per origin, reconstructed-origin share
report must publish the REAL_TIME-only and leave-one-episode-out sensitivities
report must reference this preregistration sha256 and the coverage tree digest
aggregates only: no raw series values and no per-origin forecasts are committed

post_hoc_prohibitions: must not change the window dates, the lens thresholds, the revision classes or the series classification after seeing any extended-window result
must not add, remove or reclassify a series to improve a result
must not tune a model parameter, threshold or hyperparameter on the held-out W2 or on any origin inspected during an extended-window run
must not promote a DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY or NOT_AVAILABLE lens series into an admission-relevant input without a new preregistration version and hash
must not edit or delete this file; a correction is a new version with a new sha256 and a retained previous version
must not report a reconstructed-origin pass as an unconditional pass (CONDITIONAL_DATA_CLASS is mandatory)

amendment_rule.how: a new file protocols/pit_preregistration_0_4.json (or the next free number) with a new sha256 pin; this file stays unchanged in the repository
amendment_rule.requirements: reason, timestamp, the affected criteria/lenses, and a statement of what did not change; amendments before any extended-window computation are allowed and must be recorded; amendments after computation are a result-changing event and the old results remain in the reports
amendment_rule.no_retroactive: previous reports are never edited to match a new version

reproduce.reader_check: AMFE_DATA_ROOT=data/reconstructed python -c "from amfe.forecast.data import load_vintages; print(len(load_vintages('CPIAUCSL')))"
reproduce.data_source: private ALFRED artifact of the data-refresh workflow (tools/fetch_data.py); data/raw and data/reconstructed are git-ignored

limitations: this is a reconstruction audit; only ARCHIVED_PIT series use genuine archived columns, the tape series carry the declared first-print approximation and its measured revisions
the merged ALFRED archive starts at the first planned date (1990-03-31 for the dense plan); the 2-3 month start gap of the ARCHIVED_PIT lens is covered by a declared 90-day tolerance

the auxiliary relative revision class measures genuine archive revisions between the first archived column and the latest one for window observations; it is not a reconstruction error for ARCHIVED_PIT series
three series (A191RL1Q225SBEA, PCEPILFE, RSAFS) cannot be reconstructed for 1990-1996 and are excluded; their latest.csv is not a PIT substitute
the coverage report is aggregates only and is git-ignored; the audit summary is in docs/166
no extended-window evaluation has been run under this preregistration yet; no result is claimed
